popup.transitReach.gridNote: Starting from this cell (road node nearest its centre) under idealised rules: rail and flights use the fastest service per leg, with no waiting and no frequency limits; all modes assume a car at the origin. Cells not reached within 720 min are marked not covered, not 0.
popup.transitReach.islandUncovered: Not covered (island not linked by ferry or flight)
popup.transitReach.playbackNote: Idealised-rule scenario: fastest service per leg, no waiting or frequency limits, +5 min per transfer; island services ignore frequency and suspensions. Not measured.
popup.transitReach.source: OpenStreetMap (ODbL), GHSL GHS-POP R2023A (CC BY 4.0), TDX Transport Data eXchange; taipei-gis-analytics transit-reach scenario
